description: Editing a segment and assigning speakers.

preconditions: A line is said in SPEAKER_01; SPEAKER_00 is already named as the member; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: a line in SPEAKER_01; userId: the member named on SPEAKER_00; guestId: null; label: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Success with the line, the previous and new voice and newVoice false (MSG407 "Đã đổi người nói của câu này."); the line length moves with it.
cases.log: Saved: line voice and both voices speech time; audit row records the move.

preconditions: No voice is named as the member; actor is the current secretary.
Free voice labels remain on the recording.
cases.inputs: segmentId: a line in SPEAKER_01; userId: a meeting member with no voice; guestId: null; label: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Success with newVoice true (MSG407); a new voice carrying the name is created and the line moves to it.
cases.log: Saved: new voice with the assigned name; line voice and speech times; audit row records the move with newVoice true.

preconditions: A line was wrongly moved away from SPEAKER_00; that voice still exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: the moved line; userId: null; guestId: null; label: "SPEAKER_00"; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Success (MSG407); the line moves back to SPEAKER_00 and its time moves back with it.
cases.log: Saved: line voice and both voices speech time; audit row records the move.

preconditions: A line is already said in the member own voice; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: a line in the member own voice; userId: that member; guestId: null; label: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Success with newVoice false (MSG407); a change that changes nothing writes nothing.

preconditions: A line exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing line; userId: a meeting member; guestId: null; label: "SPEAKER_00"; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSpeaker (MSG317); a line is said by one voice, user or guest.

preconditions: No line or voice on the recording uses the label; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing line; userId: null; guestId: null; label: "SPEAKER_09"; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; another recording label is not one of this recording voices.

preconditions: All 100 voice labels are taken by lines or voices; the member has no voice; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: a line; userId: a meeting member with no voice; guestId: null; label: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSpeaker (MSG317); no free voice label remains.

preconditions: A line exists; actor takes part in the meeting but is not the secretary.
cases.inputs: segmentId: an existing line; userId: a meeting member; guestId: null; label: null; actorId: a member who is not the secretary.
